counterfactual_missing_items: absence of a soft, compressible consistency
absence of an echogenic hilum on ultrasonography
decisive_items: diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek
response.rationale: R1 is favored because severe pain, diffuse extraoral swelling, and ill-defined borders fit an inflammatory/reactive ectopic lymph node; lipoma is typically painless and well-circumscribed. The shared provisional-diagnosis span and non-specific US finding do not discriminate.

rejected.why: Lipoma is less consistent with severe pain and ill-defined borders; these features favor an ectopic lymph node.
